output.summary: Agency spend growth is mostly volume (77%), not rate (23%). Vacancies and resignations began rising from Q3 2024, well before St. Brennan's opened in 2026. Evidence supports a reinforcing loop. Agency share precedes charge and orientation load. Load correlates with resignations two quarters later. The 4 West pilot cut load and exhaustion against matched units. Exit interviews cite workload far more than pay. The 2025 bonus did not reduce vacancy. The proposed bonus, funded by suspending charge and preceptor differentials, would worsen the loop. Falls link is confounded by acuity and age. Time-to-hire is unmeasured. Extending the 4 West model is preferred; rate renegotiation is acceptable secondary.
